mirror.name: github
mirror.description: Caching mirror of the GitHub REST API. Storage is global -- one row per fact, no actor column -- and a read is gated by proof that the caller could have read the same thing from GitHub directly. Set GITHUB_API_URL to target a GitHub Enterprise Server instance.
